*   # Mahedy Sees One Fed Rate Hike in December, If Inflation Doesn’t Behave, More Could Come Fast

    [From kathleenhays.substack.com](https://kathleenhays.substack.com/p/mahedy-sees-one-fed-rate-hike-in)

    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/public/5/3/0/7/4/4/7/5307447.png?_=1791615092)](https://kathleenhays.substack.com/p/mahedy-sees-one-fed-rate-hike-in)

    https://kathleenhays.substack.com/p/mahedy-sees-one-fed-rate-hike-in

    Tim Mahedy is the CEO and Chief Economist at business consultancy Access/Macro drawing on his work a senior economist at KPMG, and prior to that as Chief of Staff to SF Fed President Mary Daly and a forecaster for NY Fed President John Williams to do research for corporate boards across the country.
